evidence.quote:
We further evaluate VeriTime’s reasoning quality via the

practical_problems.note: step-wise accuracy against process labels, compared with a warm-up model, and reward-component ablations; it measures intermediate-step correctness, not human review

summary: Trains compact LLMs on process-verifiable time series reasoning data with scheduled SFT and RL; accuracy rises on anomaly and other reasoning tasks, and step-level correctness against process labels is measured, but the work does not show downstream analyst benefit.
